entities.name: Michael Martínez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michael Gabriel Martínez Tiburcio is a Dominican professional baseball utility player who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Philadelphia Phillies, Pittsburgh Pirates, Cleveland Indians, Boston Red Sox, and Tampa Bay Rays. In a seven-year MLB career, Martínez played every position except catcher and first baseman.
